An optimiser engine specification

Source: R/registry.R
optim_engine.Rd

Bundles the metadata that drives selection with the adapter that maps a optim_problem to a backend optimiser and returns an optimix_result. The accepts, global, noise_tolerant, emits_map, and dimension fields are exactly what method = "auto" reads when it chooses an engine, so registering an engine and teaching the selector about it are one and the same act.

Usage

optim_engine(
  name = character(0),
  pkg = "base",
  accepts = "space_box",
  global = FALSE,
  uses_gradient = FALSE,
  noise_tolerant = FALSE,
  stochastic = FALSE,
  emits_map = FALSE,
  dim_min = 1,
  dim_max = Inf,
  available = function() NULL,
  run = function() NULL
)

Arguments

name

A single string naming the engine; this is the value passed to method =.

pkg

A single string naming the package the engine needs, or "base" when it needs nothing beyond base R.

accepts

A character vector of the design-space class names the engine can search, such as "space_box".

global

A single logical, TRUE if the engine performs global search.

uses_gradient

A single logical, TRUE if the engine uses gradients.

noise_tolerant

A single logical, TRUE if the engine handles noisy objectives well.

stochastic

A single logical, TRUE if the engine is randomised and therefore honours a seed.

emits_map

A single logical, TRUE if the engine returns a mixture-valued solution map.

dim_min, dim_max

Single numbers bounding the problem dimensions the engine supports.

available

A function of no arguments returning a single logical: is the engine usable in the current session?

run

A function taking an optim_problem and returning an optimix_result.

Value

An S7 object of class optim_engine.

See also

Other engines and registry: list_optimisers(), register_optimiser()

Examples

optim_engine(
  name = "my_solver",
  pkg = "base",
  available = function() TRUE,
  run = function(problem) NULL
)
#> <optimix::optim_engine>
#>  @ name          : chr "my_solver"
#>  @ pkg           : chr "base"
#>  @ accepts       : chr "space_box"
#>  @ global        : logi FALSE
#>  @ uses_gradient : logi FALSE
#>  @ noise_tolerant: logi FALSE
#>  @ stochastic    : logi FALSE
#>  @ emits_map     : logi FALSE
#>  @ dim_min       : num 1
#>  @ dim_max       : num Inf
#>  @ available     : function ()  
#>  @ run           : function (problem)
